journey.name: onchain original payment cancel
journey.description: Verifies the Cancel payment exit from an unresolved original software on-chain payment once its request, quote or order can no longer be re-authorized. Precondition: an onboarded funded dev wallet, PIN enabled, a synced node, and a retained unresolved prepared-send receipt for a Paykit request or Blocktank order whose candidate never reached the chain, with its exact original recipient, amount, inputs and candidate transaction IDs. Creating that fixture needs a controlled refusal, which the Capabilities table does not provide; a seeded Pending fixture must be labelled as state injection, never as proof of a native fault. Mining the 6 confirmations needs a regtest miner, so the unlock steps are Manual Tests. Manual Tests must also confirm against the backend that the cancellation spends the original inputs and pays only this wallet, and that a cancellation evicted from mempools can be replaced at a higher fee over the same inputs. See prepared-fee-recovery.md in this directory for the shared fee-recovery cases.

actions.action: Open the retained original payment's Pending screen and record its displayed transaction ID
Verify Pending says other payments remain blocked and offers Retry original payment and Cancel payment
Verify the dialog shows the original recipient and amount, explains the cancellation needs 6 confirmations, and prefills a fee rate above the original
Enter a valid fee rate that the funded fixture can support and tap Continue

Verify the exact prepared mining fee in sats is shown without a recipient amount; tap Authorize cancellation, accept any normal fee warnings, and verify the normal payment PIN screen appears before dispatch
Enter the fixture's normal payment PIN without recording entered digits

Verify Pending shows Cancellation sent with its transaction ID, says the payment can be cancelled again if the cancellation drops out of the network without confirming, no longer offers Retry original payment, and still offers Cancel payment

Wait for the wallet to sync, tap Cancel payment, verify the dialog says an earlier cancellation can be replaced only after it drops out of the network and prefills a fee rate above the cancellation just sent, and tap Continue
Verify Pending says the earlier cancellation is still pending and the payment's funds remain protected, and does not ask for a higher fee
Verify Pending still shows the same cancellation transaction ID
Close the sheet, start a new on-chain send, and verify it is refused back to the original Pending payment
After the cancellation has 6 confirmations and the wallet syncs, verify a Payment Cancelled toast appears and a new on-chain send reaches its confirmation screen
